protocol.generator: Same unchanged makeScenarioV2; 3 mechanisms × 2 scales 12/24 × 2 capacity profiles × 2 distinct repetitions = 24 cases, new seeds 71001..71024. No order generation/preview before protocol save.
protocol.decisionTime: Day start before daily atomic pickup/unloading-start/return actions. All synthetic orders, their release dates and unloading duration are known initially. Future capacity events and their duration are unknown; effects start on revealDay. No announcedDuration in any primary event.
protocol.patternAssignment: (mechanismIndex + 2*capacityIndex + scaleIndex + repeatIndex) mod 4, with zero-based indices in declared order; each pattern has six cases and each mechanism has two of each pattern. The explicit per-case shocks are authoritative.
protocol.capacityTransformation: capacity=max(0, nominal scalar resourceCapacity-reduction) while the shock is active. Normalize/realize as in V4; planner receives actual capacity only through current day and nominal unannounced future capacities. For overlaps use the V4 later-revelation then input-order rule.

methodDefinitions.dailyReopt: Invoke the same joint solveOptimized once each decision day, timeLimitSeconds=0.2, presolveV4=false, current minEventDay and fixedEvents, no initial-policy heuristic fallback. A complete checked plan executes only today; historical dates never change.
methodDefinitions.stableRetain: At each decision day first reconstruct/reprice the last complete plan for the current observed scenario and check complete coverage, all current hard constraints and fixedEvents/minEventDay. If still valid, retain its pending event dates and do not invoke the optimizer. If absent/invalid, call exactly the same solveOptimized as dailyReopt once with the same 0.2 solver limit. A valid cache is retained even if fresh optimization might reduce fees; no cost threshold, periodic refresh, hindsight, or learned trigger is added.

protocol.comparability: Same information, physical execution, constraints and per-call solver time limit; different solver-call counts and total work. Not equal episode CPU or end-to-end budgets. Report solverCalls, cacheRetentions, planningWallMs and total runtime; cache checking itself is counted. No wall-deadline claim from an advisory GLPK limit.
protocol.failureRule: A failed/infeasible/timed-out call without a complete audited plan terminates the episode and keeps its executed-event history and failure day. Do not repair with future knowledge, silently drop containers, price partial completion or replace the seed. Independently check current-day realized capacity before executing; ongoing unloading remains frozen.
protocol.revisionUnit: One pending event pickup/unloadStart/return whose planned date changes since the immediately preceding accepted plan; count only events not already executed. At first plan revisions=0. Same-fee plan changes count too. Report by case and method, not as boxes, independent events or actual dispatcher cost.
protocol.reporting: Complete execution counts and losses/wins retained. Pair terminal total/incremental fees only when both methods complete under identical shocks. Report positive/zero/negative fee differences, zero baselines, missing pairs, revision counts and solver calls on all cases and separately on complete matched episodes. No division by zero or composite score hiding failure.

Internal solver time limit is 0.2 seconds per call. Policies have different call counts and total computation; no equal total CPU claim.
Stability and fee differences use only jointly completed episodes; all failed and gained/lost episodes are listed separately.
